skill.name: design-orchestration
skill.description: Orchestrates design workflows by routing work through brainstorming, multi-agent review, and execution readiness in the correct order.
skill.summary: Routes design work through brainstorming, review, and execution readiness checks.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Design work can move to implementation before risks are understood. This skill routes Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through brainstorming, review, and readiness checks.
actual_capabilities: Routes new feature ideas to brainstorming before implementation planning.
Classifies design risk as low, moderate, or high.
Recommends or requires multi-agent review based on risk.
Checks for approved design artifacts before execution.
Identifies the next workflow step when review is incomplete.
limitations: Does not create the design itself.
Depends on separate brainstorming and review skills being available.
Does not replace product, security, or domain expert review.
Requires clear inputs about scope, risks, and success criteria.

use_cases.title: Plan a Risky Feature
use_cases.description: Route a proposed product change through design creation, risk classification, and review before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review System Changes
use_cases.description: Require extra validation when architecture decisions carry operational cost or irreversible effects.

use_cases.title: Standardize Design Gates
use_cases.description: Apply consistent readiness checks across teams before work moves into execution planning.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Design Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration for this feature idea. Determine the next required design step before implementation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a new feature proposal.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Design Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration to classify this design as low, moderate, or high risk. State whether review is recommended or required.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt after an initial design exists.

prompt_templates.title: Check Review Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration to verify whether this design has the artifacts needed for multi-agent review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt before requesting external critique.

prompt_templates.title: Gate Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration to decide whether implementation planning may begin. Cite missing artifacts and choose the next workflow step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt before moving from design to execution.

output_examples.input: A team proposes a billing migration without a completed design.
output_examples.output: The skill routes the task to brainstorming and blocks implementation until the design and decision log exist.

output_examples.input: A reviewed design has unresolved high-risk assumptions.
output_examples.output: The skill requires multi-agent review or revision before allowing implementation planning.

output_examples.input: A low-risk interface change has an approved design and complete decision log.
output_examples.output: The skill allows the workflow to proceed to implementation planning.

best_practices: Provide the current design, decision log, and known risks when invoking the skill.
Use the risk classification before choosing whether review is optional or required.
Ask for the explicit next workflow step at the end of each design phase.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to generate designs instead of routing the workflow.
Do not skip multi-agent review when the design is high risk.
Do not treat readiness checks as a replacement for testing or expert validation.

faq.question: Does this skill create design proposals?
faq.answer: No. It routes work to the appropriate design or review step.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a feature, system change, or design decision needs staged review before implementation.

faq.question: Can it approve implementation by itself?
faq.answer: It can state readiness only after required artifacts and reviews are complete.

faq.question: Does it require multi-agent review for every task?
faq.answer: No. It recommends review for moderate risk and requires it for high risk.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Provide the proposed change, current design, decision log, assumptions, and known risks.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
